request.purpose: Display-ready stone terrain tile for readable platform and floor construction.
request.integration_notes: Original source is source-only; load only the derived normalized frame at assets/normalized/platform_tile/platform_tile.png. Use at 64x64 logical pixels with linear filtering and one uniform render scale; do not stretch, resize, or repaint texture pixels. Place as a standalone TileMap or Sprite2D tile with top-left grid alignment; collision should match the visible block bounds. For longer surfaces, repeat horizontally or combine neighboring terrain variants. Preserve alpha. Visual acceptance remains pending.
